offer.text: A whole pack of the dead is shambling toward the gate. Thin them out — 8 zombies — before they reach the walls.

accept.text: Hold the line with me. The village is counting on us.

decline.text: Then bar your shutters and pray the gate holds.

in_progress.text: Is the horde thinning at all?

ready.text: Eight down at the gate! You fought like a soldier of the watch.

complete.text: The walls held because you stood at them. Honor to you.
